issues: The wide shot was a grey placeholder dashboard and the target card only said IMPACT, so the punch landed on nothing in particular
After the hit the close-up was a blank placeholder card holding for almost 3 seconds with a single readable word
Grey background with an indigo outline: outside the negative frames the shot had no colour or depth
The recovery only had a screen shake; the hit never got a visual full stop
changes: Paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion) done as a manga page: five panels with 7px ink borders and screentone telling a fictional deploy tool's pipeline (Push, Tests 214/214, Build 3.1 s, Deploy, brand panel)
The technique carries meaning: the hero panel reads DEPLOYING with a 92% bar and flips to a 140px italic DEPLOYED. on the exact stop frame, so the negative impact frame is the moment the deploy lands

The 3f negative, 34 thick wedges plus 22 needles of focus lines (new shape every frame) and ±9px red/cyan split are kept; the crash zoom to 1.74x makes the panel ~93% of frame height, with sub-frame motion blur and a sharp centre mask
On recovery a vermilion, ink-outlined BAM! sound effect stamps onto the panel corner on a spring, the bar fills vermilion and 14 regions · 0.8 s rises in
Rhythm: 0–24 frontal page establish (bar creeping, vermilion lock frame at 6–20), 6f wind-back, 6f crash zoom, 3f impact, decaying shake, then a 2s+ reading hold with a 2% push; 135f total
